The storage hierarchy, to scale

depth
time: the cage always runs at 1.6 km/h of human time (one cycle = half a second), so every round trip takes exactly the level's access time; one cycle is 11.2 cm of depth
crate
one cache line, 64 bytes: eight values of 8 bytes, the parcels of the House DBMS
block
a level, as many crates as it holds; the colour is its rack's
pallet
one page of 4 KB, 64 crates: what an SSD or a hard disk delivers at once
platter
the hard disk, its crates on its two faces; the read head sits at the Earth's centre
Round trips: the access times
